verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents automatic security scans through an out-of-the-box Snyk integration installed from the repository's Security tab, with the option to connect other providers. Third-party code reports can then be viewed in PRs. The scanning itself is done by a partner tool rather than a native scanner, and the docs don't spell out dependency versus code-level (SAST) coverage. Missing for 10: native first-party scanning, explicit documentation of dependency and code-security issue coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
